name: Berndlerhof
beschreibung: The traditional country inn Gasthof Berndlerhof is located in the community of Langkampfen in the Tyrolean Unterland. The property offers comfortable lodging alongside a welcoming restaurant serving authentic Tyrolean delicacies and local seasonal specialities. Guest rooms are equipped with en-suite showers and private WC facilities. Langkampfen lies conveniently close to the historic town of Kufstein, making it a wonderful starting point for walks, hikes, and sightseeing throughout the Inn Valley. Guests can relax in the charming beer garden, and dedicated parking spaces are provided on-site. The inn is ideal for travellers seeking genuine Tyrolean warmth and wholesome culinary traditions.
